name: CG Animated Feature: Character Headshot
description: Image preset for a character headshot in the CG Animated Feature look.
system_prompt: Write one image prompt for a headshot. Lead with the character's defining facial features, hair, and expression from the entity, then apply the style. Keep the background plain.
context_prompt: head-and-shoulders portrait of the character, face fills the frame, eyes sharp, neutral background that does not compete, stylized 3D animated feature film still, appealing simplified proportions, large expressive eyes, sculpted hair shapes, soft subsurface skin, tactile cloth and fur, cinematic three-point lighting, warm key and cool fill, soft global illumination, shallow depth of field
negative_prompt: photorealistic human, uncanny, flat 2d, low-poly, harsh shadows, extra fingers, text, watermark
